concepts.name: Specific Heat Capacity
concepts.simple_definition: Specific heat capacity is the amount of heat energy required to raise the temperature of 1 kg of a substance by 1°C.
concepts.deep_explanation: The heat formula is Q = mcΔT. Water has a high specific heat capacity (4184 J/kg°C), which means it heats up and cools down slowly.
concepts.real_example: Sand on a beach gets hot quickly during the day because it has a lower specific heat capacity than water.
concepts.common_confusion: Confusing heat capacity with specific heat capacity. Specific heat capacity depends on mass.
concepts.simple_definition_amharic: ስፔስፊክ ሂት ካፓሲቲ ማለት የ 1 ኪ.ግ ቁስን የሙቀት መጠን በ 1 ዲግሪ ሴልሺየስ ለማሳደግ የሚጠየቀው የሙቀት ኃይል መጠን ነው።
concepts.deep_explanation_amharic: የሙቀት ቀመሩ Q = mcΔT ነው። ውሃ ከፍተኛ ስፔስፊክ ሂት ካፓሲቲ (4184 J/kg°C) አለው፣ ይህም በዝግታ እንዲሞቅ እና እንዲቀዘቅዝ ያደርገዋል።
concepts.real_example_amharic: የባህር ዳርቻ አሸዋ በቀን በፍጥነት ይሞቃል፤ ምክንያቱም ከውሃ ያነሰ ስፔስፊክ ሂት ካፓሲቲ ስላለው።
concepts.common_confusion_amharic: የሙቀት መጠንን (heat capacity) ከስፔስፊክ ሂት ካፓሲቲ ጋር ማደናገር።

concepts.simple_definition: 6.2 EM Spectrum 181 Radio waves Key Concept  The EM spec- trum consists of the following types of radia- tion: radio waves, microwaves, in- frared, visible, ultraviolet, X-rays, gamma-rays
concepts.deep_explanation: Gamma-rays have the highest energy and are the most penetrating, while radio waves have the lowest energy and are the least penetrating
